description: Does an agent find PTPGE on this domain? Fetches exactly what a checkout agent fetches — https://<domain>/.well-known/ucp (the UCP manifest and its ptpge block), the vendor declaration at /.well-known/ptpge/declaration.json, the identity in the vendors register, and a supplier catalogue if the domain is a maker — and validates each against its published JSON Schema (ptpge.org/v1/schemas/) and the vocabulary. Returns a verdict (ready | partial | none), one line per step with errors and warnings, what the agent sees (name, identity, products, capability counts) and what is missing with where to fix it. Read-only; nothing is stored. Use it to answer 'is <printer> agent-ready?' or 'why does my declaration not validate?'.

document.description: Optional: https URL of a declaration or catalogue hosted elsewhere than the known path (a register entry marked «hosted»).

domain.description: A hostname or URL, e.g. trykkverk.no or https://trykkverk.no/.
